scope: Exit confirmation native-ad image concepts only; no runtime changes.

prompts.center-dialog:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a realistic, production-quality Android mobile app exit-confirmation popup concept for the existing Korean Focus Friend app. Focused primary screen with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, purposeful spacing, readable Korean text. Output ONE standalone full-height app screen, target logical viewport 390 x 844, render at 780 x 1688 pixels (same aspect ratio as the home reference). No comparison board and no external concept title or numbering.
References are attached as actual files. The Focus Friend home screenshot is the mandatory identity/background reference: cozy hand-illustrated sunset study room, cute orange red panda, green overalls, books, plants, amber desk lamp, cream text. Preserve that recognizable app home as the dimmed background without changing to a generic productivity UI. RandomFocus screenshot is a FUNCTIONAL reference for exit confirmation + a clearly marked native advertisement + separate cancel/exit controls; do not copy its purple branding. Focus Friend update sheet is a SURFACE STYLE reference for cream paper, brown typography, amber buttons and large friendly rounded corners.
The screen is idle home with Android back having opened an APP EXIT confirmation, not a focus session ending or completing. Dim underlying room/UI enough for the dialog to be legible. No completion reward or new timer state.
Typography: Pretendard-like Korean sans serif, 23-26px bold main popup title, 14-16px body and buttons (logical pixels). Existing colors: amber #FFC16F, deep plum #292630, warm cream #FFF8E8, brown #3F2C24, muted brown #806C5E, fine beige divider. Match the attached current sheet. Use simple hierarchy and one subtle separator, no gratuitous cards inside cards except the single clearly bounded native advertisement.
The native ad must look distinct from the app message: visible small badge "광고", advertiser text "예시 광고주", small AdChoices-style outlined information triangle at top-right, high-quality real-looking photo of a cream notebook and black pen on a warm desk, headline "하루를 담는 노트", one supporting line "생각을 차분히 기록해 보세요", and separate outlined advertisement CTA "자세히 보기". This is clearly fictional sample ad content, no Google brand, fake ratings or real advertiser claims. Do not imply the ad is the app's recommendation. Keep any mascot outside the advertisement.
Below the ad, at least 24px blank separation then a thin divider before a dedicated exit action area. Two unobstructed equally large 48px-tall app buttons: "취소" on left in an outlined/quiet cream treatment and "앱 종료" on right in amber with deep plum text. The ad CTA and app exit must never overlap or appear to be the same control. No countdown, lock, forced ad viewing, loading UI, extra settings, upsell or checkbox.
Avoid crowding, clipping, stretched screenshots or warped typography. Keep all app exit controls visible in this frame without scrolling. Show app content only: no device bezel, phone body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock/signal/battery icons, OS home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask, device shadow, explanatory annotations or watermark. Background in-app navigation can appear behind the dim layer, as in the source.
Current date anchor is 2026-11-07 America/Mexico_City; no calendar date is needed. Keep home timer 25:00 as a duration, not a wall clock.
Direction name: 포근한 중앙 팝업.
Composition: A centered floating warm cream dialog, logical x18 y130 width354 height584, radius26. Keep dim sunset home visible around all four edges. Centered headline "앱을 종료할까요?" and one centered line "오늘도 함께해 줘서 고마워요." at the top; no extra header icon. Below generous gap, a native ad area close to 320x340 logical pixels: small attribution row, large landscape notebook media image around 300x165, strong headline, supporting line, outlined full-width ad CTA. Footer with divider and the two same-sized cancel/exit buttons. Refined, familiar, clean, production-feasible. Match the exit-dialog hierarchy from RandomFocus with Focus Friend's cream and amber styling.
